# SuperComment

> SuperComment is a comment layer for deployed websites. Reviewers click any
> element and comment, no accounts needed, and your AI coding agent gets
> everything it needs to ship the fix, over MCP.

## Docs
- [Quickstart](https://supercomment.dev/docs/quickstart): embed the script tag, register a deploy URL, share a review link
- [MCP setup](https://supercomment.dev/docs/mcp): connect Claude Code, Cursor, or any MCP client
- [What gets captured](https://supercomment.dev/docs/capture): the twelve signals and redaction behavior
- [Security model](https://supercomment.dev/security): dormancy, tokens, permissions
